# DukaKonnect

> DukaKonnect keeps the books for small shops in Kenya: sales, stock, credit (deni) and spending, recorded day by day on a phone, so the owner knows what they actually took home. Free to start.

DukaKonnect is a web app, installable on Android and iOS, built for small retail shops (dukas) in Kenya that run on a paper daybook. It is made by Eddie Ezekiel Ochieng.

## What it does

- Record a sale by tapping an item; stock adjusts itself.
- Negotiated prices, within a range the owner sets for each item.
- Deni: credit sales and repayments, with a dated payment history per customer.
- Restocking that updates the average unit cost and logs the spend.
- One-off, variable and recurring expenses.
- Reports over any date range, exportable to a spreadsheet.
- Staff logins that can sell and check stock but never see cost prices, spending or profit.

## Pricing

Free while it is getting started. Shops that join now keep their price when paid plans arrive, and recording a sale will always be free.
